title: KILL AURA AUTO CLAIM QUESTALBUMS AUTO CRAFT MOUNT MORE
features:
Script / Feature Description
NPC Level Teleport Select an NPC level from a dropdown, then toggle to fly exactly above it. Automatically switches to another NPC when one dies or becomes uncatchable.
Kill Aura Automatically fires your held weapon at the nearest NPC. Supports shotguns (pellet spread) and rifles.
Equip Best Mount Instantly equips your strongest owned mount with one click.
Auto Catch Turns on the game’s built‑in auto‑catch feature.
Auto Battle Turns on the game’s built‑in auto‑battle feature.
Auto Craft All Mounts Continuously crafts every possible mount using available materials.
Auto Claim Quests Rapidly claims all completed daily and main quests (every 0.01s).
Auto Claim Albums Rapidly claims all album rewards for every NPC (every 0.01s).
Capsule Shop Multi‑select capsules, set buy speed, and auto‑purchase them.
Gun Shop Multi‑select guns, set buy speed, and auto‑purchase them.
Food Shop Multi‑select food, set quantity and buy speed, auto‑purchase.
Changelog Tab Shows version history, bug fixes, and planned updates.
